needsAttention.detail: Flagged p1 since Sept 14. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and it sells out. Book refundable now, adjust dates later — it costs nothing to hold.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south
